title: Change Order Allowances and Redesign Fees by Ridgeline Door Series
content:
Change-order allowances and the series redesign fee for Entry & Patio Door Contracts.

| Door series | Customer change orders written without a change-order fee | Change-order fee for each change order beyond the free count | Most customer change orders a contract may carry | Redesign fee for switching into this series after the final measure |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Portal 310 Steel Entry Door | 1 | $95.00 | 4 | $125.00 |
| Ridgeline Portal 520 Smooth Fiberglass Entry Door | 1 | $95.00 | 4 | $125.00 |
| Ridgeline Glide 720 Vinyl Sliding Patio Door | 1 | $95.00 | 4 | $150.00 |
| Ridgeline Portal 640 Woodgrain Fiberglass Entry Door | 2 | $85.00 | 5 | $150.00 |
| Ridgeline Glide 840 Fiberglass Sliding Patio Door | 2 | $85.00 | 5 | $175.00 |
| Ridgeline Hinge 960 Wood-Clad French Patio Door | 3 | $75.00 | 6 | $175.00 |

## Definitions

- **Free change orders**: customer change orders per contract written without a change-order fee.
- **Change-order fee**: the administrative fee for each customer change order beyond the free count.
- **Most change orders**: the most customer change orders a contract may carry; further changes are refused.
- **Redesign fee**: the fee for switching the contract to another door series after the final measure and before order release. The table states it for each series as the series being switched into.

## Hypothetical readings

- A Ridgeline Hinge 960 Wood-Clad French Patio Door contract has 3 free change orders and a ceiling of 6, so at most 3 of its change orders can carry the $75.00 fee.
- A Ridgeline Portal 310 Steel Entry Door contract has 1 free change order and a ceiling of 4, so at most 3 of its change orders can carry the $95.00 fee.
- A switch into the Ridgeline Glide 840 Fiberglass Sliding Patio Door series after the final measure is associated with a redesign fee of $175.00.
